page_title: PSG 3-1 MET | PSG v Metz 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+6' Good chance! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
90+2' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Kang-In Lee goes off and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) comes on.
90+1' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Manuel Ugarte will be replaced by Ethan Mbappe (PSG).
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Carlos Soler (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Bradley Barcola.
90+1' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for PSG.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' It is time for a substitution. Ablie Jallow (Metz) is on for Danley Jean Jacques.
90' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is caught offside!
87' Lamine Camara (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' 3 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Kylian Mbappe (PSG), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 3:1.
80' Alexandre Oukidja leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
79' A pass lands at the feet of Kylian Mbappe (PSG) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Metz.
72' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Matthieu Udol (Metz) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
72' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner.
71' Today's match ends for Cheikh Sabaly who will be replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
71' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Simon Elisor (Metz) replacing Joel Asoro.

71' A snap shot by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Gianluigi Donnarumma produces a good save to thwart him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Metz are going to take it.
70' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Metz win a corner.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Asensio (PSG) replaces Randal Kolo Muani.
65' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) replaces Milan Skriniar.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
65' Bradley Barcola (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.
62' Substitution. Lamine Camara (Metz) in, Habib Maiga out.
60' 2 - 0 Brilliant finish! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Vitinha, then produced a nice strike into the top right corner. The score is 2:0.
58' Some neat passing and movement from PSG as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
51' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Alexandre Oukidja has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
49' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Kang-In Lee plays it into the box, and Vitinha (PSG) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
42' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
41' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:1. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
35' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

34' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
34' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

34' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. PSG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
32' Christophe Herelle (Metz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
32' Kang-In Lee (PSG) works the corner short.
32' The ball is cleared after Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
28' The PSG players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Kylian Mbappe (PSG). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
21' 81:19 – the ratio of ball possession.
17' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
17' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Metz will have a corner.
12' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

10' Alexandre Oukidja makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Vitinha (PSG) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
9' Milan Skriniar (PSG) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul. Free kick. Metz will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' PSG hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Ruddy Buquet.
